question: In 2025, which district's households used more water per resident per day, Lindenmoor or Kelmarsh, and by how many litres per resident per day?

log.user:
In 2025, which district's households used more water per resident per day, Lindenmoor or Kelmarsh, and by how many litres per resident per day?

Reply with the ANSWER line only. Do not show any working.
End your reply with exactly one final line in this format:
ANSWER: <district name or yes/no> | <number>
Write the number as a plain number (no units, no thousands separators), rounded to 3 decimal places.

calls.text:
I need water use per resident per day for both districts, using 2025 water use and 2025 census population.

Lindenmoor: households used 2,151,400 cubic metres = 2,151,400,000 litres in 2025. Population 2025: 29,051. Per year per resident: 2,151,400,000 / 29,051 = 74,054.... Let me compute: 29,051 × 74,000 = 2,149,774,000; remainder 1,626,000; /29,051 = 55.97. So 74,055.97 litres per year. Per day: 74,055.97 / 365 = 202.89... 365 × 202 = 73,730; remainder 325.97; /365 = 0.8930. So 202.893 litres/day.

Kelmarsh: 1,739 megalitres = 1,739,000,000 litres. Population 2025: 24,117. Per year: 1,739,000,000 / 24,117 = 72,098.... 24,117 × 72,000 = 1,736,424,000; remainder 2,576,000; /24,117 = 106.82. So 72,106.82 litres per year. Per day: 72,106.82 / 365 = 197.553... 365 × 197 = 71,905; remainder 201.82; /365 = 0.5529. So 197.553 litres/day.

Lindenmoor uses more. Difference: 202.893 − 197.553 = 5.340.

Checking more precisely: Lindenmoor 202.8930, Kelmarsh 197.5529, difference 5.3401 → 5.340.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.340
